hypotheses.justification: Replace the cell-counting step using cellPreimageEquiv. If d ≠ 0, hd and Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero give finiteness of each centre fibre, so Nat.card_sigma gives the required count. If d = 0, every centre fibre is empty or infinite by Nat.card_eq_zero. Their sigma type is therefore empty or infinite, hence also has Nat.card zero. The existing finite-dimensional sum argument then applies without hfin, including when C is empty.

Keeping hfin, hd identifies each centre fibre with Fin d via Finite.equivFinOfCardEq. Together with cellPreimageEquiv, this identifies the lifted n-cells with cell C n × Fin d. Nat.card_prod gives the required cell-count identity even when cell C n is infinite or empty, and when d = 0. Unfold cwEulerChar and use finsum_congr and mul_finsum over ℤ instead of truncating to a finite-dimensional sum; mul_finsum requires no finite-support assumption.
